title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/campaign/trading-and-rarity.yaml
description: The purchase procedure: how a rare item is searched for and how equipment moves between a warrior, the warband and its stash. The rule reads the rarity of the requested item from `trading-post.yaml` instead of repeating `Rare N`, and the item is named by the caller, so `$requested_item_id` is a parameter and not an id. Rarity rolls, bought items and stash contents are campaign state and stay outside the KB.

effect_ids.description: Effects of this catalogue a warband's own special rules may modify.

modifiers.description: Modifiers a warband's special rules apply to the test. Empty today: the base test is recorded, and a modifier is added as data when a source declares one.

market_catalog.description: Market document of this same directory the test reads the rarity from.

rarity_test.description: One rarity test. It carries no `Rare N`: the target is read from the market catalogue for the item the caller asked about.

actor.description: Who may attempt the test. A Hero taken out of action is not an `eligible_hero`; common items do not use this test at all.

attempt_limit.description: How often the actor may try. Currently one attempt per eligible Hero.

success_when.description: How the roll is compared with the target rarity.

units_per_success.description: How many units of the requested item one successful test buys.

target_rarity.description: Where the target of the test is read from. The item is the one the caller requests, so `item_id` is the `$requested_item_id` parameter rather than a canonical catalogue entry.

source.description: How the value is obtained. `catalog_field` reads it from a catalogue document.

catalog.description: Catalogue the value is read from, e.g. `campaign/trading-post`.

item_id.description: The requested item: the caller's `$requested_item_id` parameter, not a canonical catalogue entry.

field.description: Dotted path of the value inside that catalogue record, e.g. `availability.rarity`.

allocation.description: How equipment moves and is valued when sold, hoarded or reassigned.

allocation_rule.description: One allocation rule: from where, to where, under which condition and at which price.

to.description: Where it goes. `none` states that the equipment is lost.

price_rule.description: How the equipment is valued, when selling. `half_of_listed_price` halves the basic cost.
